SPACE

CHRONICLES

Art Installation & Experimental Typography

My Role

Visual Design / Programming & Implementation /

Interaction Design / Installation Fabrication

Grounded in Linguistic Relativity, Space Chronicles

explores how language might evolve through

interstellar migration. The Moon, Mars and Neptune

frame three speculative worlds.

Through a space keyboard, visitors release

redesigned characters into descending text streams, turning each keystroke into a cultural signal to an unknown world.
